prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate exactly ONE high-fidelity Simplified Chinese DooKnow BLOG OWNER MANAGEMENT desktop design around 1536×1024, straight-on complete application canvas, no device/browser frame or captions. Image1 matching actual blog baseline determines role, content, real module navigation, selected state and existing controls. Image2 PILOT-WS-001 is STYLE ONLY: blue #4566c6, selected #edf1ff, white main/surfaces, #f7f8fa light rail, #272b3a text/#657084 muted, #e6e9f1 fine lines, 8px radii, compact readable hierarchy and flat aligned cards. Do not copy note tree, empty-note content or ToDoo product features.
Keep ACTUAL BLOG HOST NAVIGATION ONLY: narrow approximately64px blog-specific left rail, top 返回 back button; module destinations 概览, 文章, 装修主页, 分类与标签; bottom 站点设置. Select only the current destination. Do not add owner avatar/recent/favorites/trash/settings rail or more navigation. Existing module header shows book icon and 博客 title, subtitle 从笔记选稿，整理文章与自己的站点。, right source state badge 站点未开启 and blue plus 选择笔记 action. No 访问站点 because saved enabled=false. Preserve pale warning banner with lock: 站点尚未开启。你可以先准备文章，开启后已发布内容才会公开。 and right action 前往设置 →.
Only restyle actual controls, layout hierarchy/density/spacing/alignment. Do not fabricate published/connected/success state or change business permissions. No team/member/AI/social controls or API requestId/version/hash/cursor/CSRF fields, no ToDoo brand/task data. Local note saves, metadata saves, explicit article publishing and separately saved site enabled state remain distinct. One coherent selected state, no simultaneous dialogs/all-state cards. Full source contracts are metadata, not product inputs.
SELECTED PAGE 博客文章列表, EXACT ACTUAL EMPTY LIBRARY baseline. Blog rail 文章 active, site remains disabled. Preserve main heading 文章, helper 公开的是发布时的快照。编辑原稿后，手动发布更新。, right icon-only refresh button (aria label 刷新文章). Main split pane has bounded left article list approximately380px wide with light-gray surface and white right detail placeholder. Left toolbar search field exact placeholder 搜索文章…; closed state select 全部状态; muted 0 篇文章, then file icon with 还没有博客文章 and text action 从笔记中选稿 →. No article rows or selected article because posts empty, no invented results/status counters. Clear-search/filter action is hidden because actual library is empty with default query/filter; do not show it. Right large placeholder has book icon, headline 为一篇好文章，留一个位置, body 选择左侧文章，或从知识库中选一篇笔记。, existing outlined 选择笔记. No metadata editor fields in this selected empty state, no categories/tags chips, error/banner beyond existing disabled-site warning, no preview/publish button or imported public-blog navigation. Preserve all baseline entry actions and complete module host.

PB-031权限：Owner session required for /api/blog; no anonymous management surface. Publication snapshots and site enabled state remain independently controlled.

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

同renderer的message/data/动作guard变体由stateCoverage精确绑定，只声称代表状态可见，不假称互斥状态共存。协议不伪造成输入；源码已有只读任务/回执编号保留占位显示。生成不等于实测或批准；逐图功能/权限/响应式及全局评审后才可开发。
